Chapter 511: Chapter 11: Suggesting Inviting the Galaxy Master Over (Please Subscribe)_2

Even some of the strongest beings within the Ninth Rank lifeforms were no match for Lin Yuan.

Of course, being no match here was entirely in terms of Spirit Will and the various Cosmic Forces.

The power that Ninth Rank lifeforms possessed far exceeded just these aspects, but the Nine Floors Dark Tower specifically tested these areas.

“It’s a pity, you came too late. If you had appeared while the master was still here, the rewards you would have received would be far more than just these treasures,” Stone Statue Shen Ji sighed.

Given the talent and aptitude Lin Yuan had shown, had the Moyu Tower Master known, he would definitely have been cultivated like a precious treasure. But now, there was no choice but to make do with these treasures for emergencies.

…

...

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan once again opened his eyes.

“The second layer is too difficult.”

Lin Yuan pondered solemnly. Based on the experience of the First Layer of the Black Tower, after walking one-third of the distance, illusory creatures condensed out of thin air would appear.

Yet Lin Yuan hadn’t even seen these illusory creatures before he was crushed by the omnipresent pressure; dozens of Cosmic Forces could not withstand it.

“If I had comprehended the Complete Space Rules, could I break through the second layer?” Lin Yuan wondered to himself.

While the Complete Space Rules didn’t allow Lin Yuan to have the energy to teleport or shift in the Second Layer of the Black Tower…

…his command over the Space Rules allowed him to greatly diminish the overwhelming pressure that bore down on him.

Space Rules were mysterious and unpredictable. With the power of the Space Rules, Lin Yuan could completely twist and stretch the space within inches around him to form a vast space of thousands of miles.

Thus, even the greatest pressure would be significantly weakened upon entering this space.

“It feels like even with the Complete Space Rules apprehended, the hope to break through the second layer is still slim,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

According to Stone Statue Shen Ji, the Second Layer of the Black Tower was entirely prepared for Ninth Rank lifeforms, and only the most powerful among Ninth Rank lifeforms could hope to break through.

In other words, most Ninth Rank lifeforms had no hope of breaking through the second layer.

And while not all Ninth Rank lifeforms had mastered the Complete Space Rules, it was clear that ‘most’ could not be associated with this feat.

Many Ninth Rank lifeforms who had mastered the Complete Space Rules still could not break through the second layer.

“I have another trump card, which is the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement,'” Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

The reason he hadn’t used the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ while attempting the second layer earlier had been simply because it was pointless; at that point, Lin Yuan had only completed a third of the journey.

Using Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ then, with only ten breaths’ duration, he could not have possibly covered the remaining two-thirds of the distance.

“I’ll see when the time comes.”

Lin Yuan’s stream of thought receded.

The rewards from the Nine Floors Dark Tower were too rich for Lin Yuan to let such an opportunity slip by casually.

Even if he couldn’t break through the second layer at the Eighth Layer, once he stepped into the Ninth Rank, he would definitely try again.

“World Tree…”

Lin Yuan calmed his mind and looked at a sapling in front of him, with a fervent look in his eyes.

“This Moyu Tower Master, in terms of spatial attainment, has reached an unbelievable level. He just sent this World Tree sapling to me following the Magic Jade Mark…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was filled with emotion.

What had descended to the Demon Jade Space was just a wisp of Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will, unable to bring back any physical item.

Even knowing that the Demon Jade Space was not in the Main World and was incredibly distant from it, still being able to accomplish this feat, astonished Lin Yuan himself.

This was akin to the Door to the Myriad Realms.

The Door to the Myriad Realms, as long as sufficient World-Breaking Origin Force was paid, could also transport items from the Main World into various realms, or bring items from those realms back to the Main World.

Of course, it was but a similarity.

The task of carrying items through the Myriad Rank Gateway involved crossing different dimensional strata, which transcended the concept of space itself, countless times more sophisticated than what the Moyu Tower Master had achieved.

However distant the Demon Jade Space was from the Main World, it was still within the same stratum and the same dimension.

“Let’s plant the World Tree in the Inner World quickly.”

With a mere thought, Lin Yuan brought the World Tree sapling into his Inner World.

In the center of his Inner World, vast enough to span billions of miles, the figure of Lin Yuan appeared, holding a sapling half a meter tall.

Rustling.

Lin Yuan gently placed the World Tree sapling on the ground.

The sapling’s roots began to burrow into the soil, slowly absorbing the power of the World.

“Hmm?”

“A very peculiar feeling?”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted,

As the World Tree took root in his Inner World, Lin Yuan had a strange sensation.

It was as if the World Tree was a descendant of his own bloodline.

“It’s absorbing the power of the World…” Lin Yuan felt clearly that the World Tree sapling was slowly absorbing the power of the World into its trunk.

As the power of the World entered the sapling, Lin Yuan also sensed that he was rapidly Refining the World Tree sapling.

“There’s no noticeable change.”

Lin Yuan briefly sensed his Inner World and found the World Tree sapling hadn’t had any significant effect yet.

“Let’s take it slow.”

Lin Yuan understood that the World Tree was too small at present, and even if its quality was astoundingly high, it could not have an impact on a World spanning billions of miles.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

After settling the World Tree sapling,

Lin Yuan began to contemplate “Void Interpretation.”

The evolutionary scholars of Human Civilization in the Main World had divided Complete Space Rules into basic spatial models and core spatial models.

Only those who had apprehended these two types of spatial models could master the Complete Space Rules.

But this was merely the understanding of those pioneering evolutionary scholars of Human Civilization. In fact, the Space Rules were boundless and infinite. How could a mere few thousand or tens of thousands of spatial models encompass the true Space Rules.
